content: Alt text paths per platform: Shopify - admin > theme editor sidebar > click image section > enter alt text in dialog > Save (also Settings > Files or product media page > Alt text field). Webflow - select image element > Settings panel (gear icon) > Alt Text field; can bind to CMS field for dynamic/bulk cases. Wix - Media Manager > select image > Settings > Alt Text field. Squarespace - edit image block > Edit > Filename/Alt Text field in image options.
